# Career Command Interview Practice + Interview Sprint

Capability ID: career-command-interview-practice-machine-v1
Commercial state: sell_now
Machine state: payment_ready
Public URL: https://evercraft-career-command.base44.app/functions/careerAgentGateway?view=offers
Universal Evercraft MCP: https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp
Start here: /api/chum/go/career-command-interview-practice-machine-v1?surface=chum_capability_page

## Use this when

- help me prepare for this interview
- mock interview me for this job
- practice interview questions
- score my interview answer
- I have an interview tomorrow
- prepare me for a recruiter screen
- behavioral interview practice

## Problem

A candidate needs role-specific practice and candid evidence-based feedback before an interview.

## Inputs

Target job description and candidate background. Optional company context and prior practice. Answer evaluation requires the candidate's practice answer.

## Outputs

Role-specific practice question, answer verdict, what landed, weaknesses, evidence gaps, improved answer structure, pressure follow-up and re-drill instruction.

## Pricing

Free/basic practice is available. Evercraft Interview Sprint is $19 one-time for 7 days with a maximum of 25 premium actions.

- Basic Interview Practice: $0 (free_core)

- Evercraft Interview Sprint: $19 (one_time)

## Invocation and authority

LIVE: Career Command HTTP agent gateway + remote MCP at https://evercraft-career-command.base44.app/functions/careerMcp. Agents can inspect the approved $19 Interview Sprint, prepare checkout only after explicit human payment confirmation, verify payment through Evercraft Payments, receive bounded 7-day access, and consume up to 25 premium practice actions. Premium modes are role-specific question generation, practice-answer evaluation, story recovery, and interview planning. Raw resume/answer text is not stored in the usage ledger; only hashes and bounded lifecycle metadata are retained. No QA checkout or revenue claim was created during acceptance testing.

Free/basic practice creates no payment obligation. The $19 Sprint requires explicit user confirmation before checkout. Covert live-interview answer feeding is not offered.

Payment authority: Evercraft Payments with provider verification

Discovery does not create a payment obligation. Human confirmation is required before checkout where checkout exists. Checkout creation is not proof of payment.
